rules.sentence: Screen patients for risk factors that increase susceptibility to osteomyelitis, such as diabetes or recent surgery.
Implement culture-directed antibiotic therapy based on pathogen identification and resistance patterns.
The standard treatment for chronic and refractory osteomyelitis includes surgical debridement and culture-directed antibiotics.

Although no randomized trials of hyperbaric oxygen therapy for osteomyelitis have been conducted, hyperbaric oxygen treatments are considered a Class II recommendation by the American Heart Association (AHA) for treating chronic, refractory osteomyelitis.
Infection in bone is one of the causes of a nonhealing wound and should be suspected and tested for as soon as possible when a patient presents with a chronic, nonhealing wound.
